title: Row augmentation for a nonnegative complex of injective sheaves
statement: Let C have v-small Hom sets and finite wide pullbacks, and let J admit sheafification for v-small abelian groups. Let K be any Nat-indexed cochain complex of abelian sheaves with every K.X q injective. Let pi_i : U_i -> X be a family indexed by a type in universe v whose generated sieve covers X. Apply the Mathlib Cech functor to K degreewise, with the Cech index first, and totalize by finite coproducts. For every n in Nat, its degree-n homology is isomorphic to degree n of the integer extension by zero of K evaluated at X. No resolution of F, Ext groups, or sheaf cohomology occur in this assertion.

source.place: Step 3; Row augmentation for a nonnegative complex of injective sheaves

proof.text: Pass from J to its precoverage and choose the covering fibre products. Apply injective Cech acyclicity in the aligned universe v. The chosen-product comparison transports this result to the Mathlib Cech complex. Thus augmenting a row by K^q(X) gives an exact row: degree-zero cohomology is sections and positive cohomology vanishes.

Restriction into the (0,q) summand of the total complex defines the augmentation. Its Cech differential vanishes, restriction commutes with K differential, and the vertical sign is one. The mapping cone, with augmented Cech degrees starting at -1, is bounded below; its row filtration is finite in every total degree.

The row spectral sequence of this cone has zero first page, hence zero abutment by finite convergence. The cone is acyclic and the augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism. Invert its homology isomorphism and use extension-by-zero homology comparison in nonnegative degrees. Degree zero has zero incoming differential. For an empty covering, the sheaf condition forces all sections on X to be zero, so the argument still applies.

theorem injective_cech_total_sections
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasFiniteWidePullbacks C] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) ℕ)
    (hK : ∀ q : ℕ, Injective (K.X q)) (X : C)
    {ι : Type v} {U : ι → C} (π : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hπ : Sieve.ofArrows U π ∈ J X) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty
      (((HomologicalComplex₂.flip
        (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v} ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringLeft _ _ AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj (Over.forget X).op ⋙
          cechComplexFunctor (fun i ↦ Over.mk (π i))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℕ)).obj K)).total (.up ℕ)).homology n ≅
        (((sheafToPresheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v} ⋙
          (evaluation Cᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{v}).obj (op X)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj (K.extend ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).homology (n : ℤ))
